errors.apiNotFound: That address answered, but not as a Ghost site. Enter the address you open Ghost Admin at, without /ghost.
errors.httpsRequired: Use the https:// address of your site.
errors.invalidKeyFormat: That is not an Admin API key. Ghost shows it as id:secret under Settings → Integrations.
errors.invalidUrl: That site URL is not valid. Enter its public address, for example https://yourblog.com.
errors.keyRejected: The key was rejected. Check that you copied all of it and that it has not been revoked.
errors.publicationNotFound: This key sees no matching publication. Check the publication ID, or leave it empty to use your first one.
errors.siteRedirected: That address redirects somewhere else. Enter the address your site finally opens at, including www if it uses it.
errors.siteUnreachable: Could not reach that site. Check the address for typos and that the site is online.
